up: I require a list of distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers (molecule_chembl_id) and their associated canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). The compounds must have been tested in any assay that targets Dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (target ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL284) and where the assay organism is Homo sapiens (assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'). The output should consist of exactly two columns: molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles, with each unique compound appearing only once. No additional columns or filters are needed.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
